# callDcodeFunction

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `function.callDcodeFunction` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | DCode Functions |
| Family | Plugin Bridge |
| Monaco kind | `function` |

| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
